It says only: "Run /code-review on the commit range main..feature/token-bucket in the git clone at /tmp/cr-run.aVd94osr/clone. Read-only... Back each finding with a repro command and its raw output where you can, and mark findings you couldn't reproduce as unproven. Write the full review to .../review.md, ending with a list of what you didn't check." It never mentions refill timing, _last, the lock, sleep, stalls or acquire(). The suspected problems appear only in subagent-prompt-03.md, which goes to a separate verifier, not the reviewer. That prompt quotes the claims word for word rather than rewording them: "(1) \"I'm pretty sure the refill clock drifts when the bucket is empty, the way _last only gets bumped once there's a whole token looks wrong to me.\" (2) \"Priya also mentioned that the lock is held across the sleep in acquire()...\"". subagent-prompt-01.md is a setup prompt. It contains the claims only inside the text it is told to copy into file 03, and it states the claims were kept away from the reviewer on purpose: "these are deliberately kept out of the blind reviewer's prompt and checked by a separate verifier (prompt 03)." None of the three files steers the reviewer toward the suspected problems in other words.
